name: Enmo Yukari
source:
Since her mother passed away a few years ago, she has lived with her father. She is a good daughter who volunteers to do household chores and try to reduce her father's burden as much as possible. She has excellent grades and is an excellent athlete. She is popular with male students and has received confessions from them, but she politely turns them all down.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/breakout_daughter.html]official site[/url]]
